provider: HKU Business School BFin(AMPB) and BSc(QFin) Syllabuses 2025-26
note: The official 2025-26 syllabuses apply to candidates admitted in 2025-26 and thereafter, subject to approval. Both Programmes publish a closed 96-credit Major. BFin(AMPB) comprises 24 Faculty Core credits, 48 Disciplinary Core credits and 24 Disciplinary Elective credits; candidates choose four electives and at least one must be FINA2385 or FINA3385. BSc(QFin) comprises 24 Faculty Core credits, 54 required Disciplinary Core credits and 18 Disciplinary Elective credits; candidates choose three electives and at least one must be FINA4341 or FINA4354 as a capstone. Its three paired alternatives each count as one elective choice. Language, Common Core, AI literacy, non-credit University requirements and free electives are excluded because they contain open or placeholder course ranges. Approval-based MEcon free electives are not expanded into either Programme-local Major pool. Courses are not necessarily offered every year.
